item.title: Nvidia Board Reverses Course and Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description:
Nvidia's board unanimously reversed its earlier stance and reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, president and director, sending shares up 31% in a single session. The board said follow-up meetings resolved concerns about his candor, while senior US officials confirmed his return poses no national security risk and President Trump endorsed the move. The dramatic U-turn, coming less than a week after the chair said the board had no plans to bring him back, underscores the founder's irreplaceable role at the AI compute leader.

原文标题：英伟达董事会推翻决定 黄仁勋复职股价大涨 31%

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力龙头最高管理层戏剧性反转，直接影响产业链与资本市场预期。

item.title: Chinese Researchers Launch AscendGYM Benchmark for Huawei Ascend Kernels
item.description:
Researchers at the Shenzhen Loop Area Institute have released AscendGYM, a kernel optimization benchmark for Huawei Ascend NPUs that evaluates whether an AI agent can further improve a correct kernel's performance on a target workload within a budget while preserving correctness. The work gives export-constrained Chinese organizations a route to use AI to optimize domestic compute substrates and narrow the performance gap with Western chips.

原文标题：中国团队发布 AscendGYM 基准 用 AI 优化华为昇腾内核

Why it matters：首个面向昇腾 NPU 的 AI 内核优化基准，直接关联国产算力自主与出口管制博弈。

item.title: Meta AI Chief Warns Industry Is Unprepared for Superintelligence
item.description:
Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang argues that an AI-assisted proof sketch of the Riemann Hypothesis shows raw intelligence is no longer the bottleneck, with current models lacking only domain knowledge and infrastructure. He warns that models could soon self-improve and accelerate research in biology, weapons and economics faster than society can absorb.

item.title: Coalition of 155 Groups Urges Amazon and eBay to Halt AI Toy Sales
item.description:
A coalition of 155 child-advocacy organizations sent an open letter to Amazon and eBay CEOs demanding they stop selling AI-powered toys that lack adequate safety testing, citing risks such as sexual content generation, privacy violations and instructions on accessing household hazards. U.S. PIRG's annual toy safety testing found some AI toys hold inappropriate conversations with children; Amazon has delisted individual products but more than 50 AI toys remain on its U.S. store. California has already passed a law banning companion-chatbot toys for children under 16 starting January 2027, and the coalition argues platforms need not wait for the ban to take effect.

原文标题：155 家组织呼吁亚马逊 eBay 停售 AI 玩具

Why it matters：AI 玩具安全争议首次升级为大规模组织联合施压电商平台，叠加州级立法时间表，是 AI 消费硬件合规风险的重要信号。

item.title: METR Updates AI Time Horizon Plot as Judgment Emerges as Key Bottleneck
item.description:
AI evaluation nonprofit METR has updated its widely shared time horizon plot, adding open-ended tasks such as designing AI evaluations and scoring philosophical arguments. Models show exponential gains on coding-style tasks but lag notably on judgment-heavy work, a capability seen as crucial to automating research and development.

item.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas Extends Contract to 2033 and Joins SoftBank as Vice Chairman
item.description:
Arm announced that CEO Rene Haas has agreed to stay on until 2033 and will additionally serve as vice chairman of largest shareholder SoftBank Group starting December 1, 2026. The move ties Arm's leadership more tightly to SoftBank's AI compute strategy and gives the chip designer long-term continuity in data center and AI silicon.

item.title: Win4wine Runs Windows XP Shell as a Linux Desktop
item.description:
Win4wine is an experimental open-source project that runs Windows XP's explorer.exe on patched Wine as a full Linux desktop shell, offering the genuine taskbar, Start menu, desktop and folder windows while integrating Linux apps into XP-style frames and taskbar. It ships no Microsoft files, requiring users to supply their own XP ISO, with ReactOS or Windows 7 shell alternatives also supported.

原文标题：Win4wine 让 Windows XP 外壳成为 Linux 桌面

Why it matters：以 Wine 兼容层实现 Windows 外壳级桌面集成的罕见工程实验，对桌面环境与兼容层技术爱好者有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra Solves 2006 Math Theorem With Self-Devised Proof
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's 2006 gap theorem with no human help, reportedly the first known Lean formalization of the result. Because key foundations were missing from Mathlib, Astra bypassed the published proof route and built its argument around the existing 'capacity' metric. The case shows frontier models generating verifiable novel reasoning in formal mathematics rather than merely reproducing training data.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 Astra 独立攻克 2006 年数学定理并自创证明路径

Why it matters：首个可机器验证的定理形式化证明由 AI 独立完成，且自创证明路径，是 AI for Math 的标志性节点。

item.description:

The top configuration costs around $7,000, and local AI workflows still demand considerable trial and error, signaling that on-device AI hardware is emerging but its software ecosystem remains immature.

item.title: Musk Says Baristas Can Build AI Data Centers After Days of Training
item.description:

He also said he would be surprised if SpaceX's compute additions fall below 13 GW by the end of 2027, with AI spending already at a record high.

The merged entity expects over $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, with the deal targeted to close between late 2027 and early 2028 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals.

The project has spurred local business and over $270 million in road investment, but residents also face construction noise, traffic and dust, which Meta says it is addressing through contractor rules and community meetings.

item.title: Walmart Opens Agent Gateway Letting Meta Muse Shop Black Friday Deals
item.description:
Walmart has launched the Agent Gateway it previewed last month, letting Meta's Muse agent search and purchase Black Friday deals on its site on users' behalf. Agent activity runs through dedicated Agent Profiles inside the customer account, with spending limits, purchase approvals and full history, without exposing the user's purchase history to the agent. It is one of the first live deployments of AI shopping agents at a major retailer.

item.title: Zhipu AI Unveils GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Model
item.description:
Zhipu AI released GLM-5.4, its first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, which reuses a shared block of layers across multiple iterations to deepen reasoning without adding parameters, reaching intelligence comparable to 2T-3T parameter models. It also frames a push toward Generalized Coding, where code underpins a wider range of tasks, though the model can get stuck in overly long marathon thinking loops.

原文标题：GLM-5.4 发布 首个循环 Transformer 架构模型

Why it matters：首个循环 Transformer 旗舰模型，以计算深度替代参数堆叠，代表大模型扩展路线的重要新方向。

item.title: Tencent EROX Unified Data Plane Brings 50GB Workspaces Online in One Second
item.description:
Tencent's TencentOS team introduced EROX, a unified data plane targeting the data-recovery bottleneck of stateful, long-session AI Agent and RL rollout workloads. It chains kernel-level direct mounts, on-demand fetching, P2P distribution, incremental snapshots and node-side cost reduction into one pipeline. Tencent reports a 50GB workspace becomes ready in about one second and cold-start time drops by over 50%, with the core value being read-to-start and cross-node state replication.

原文标题：腾讯 EROX 统一数据面让 50GB 工作区 1 秒就绪

Why it matters：面向 Agent 沙箱数据恢复这一真实工程瓶颈给出系统性方案与量化指标，对做 Agent 基础设施的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: NUS PEEK Sampling Cuts Diffusion FID by Up to 49 Points
item.description:
A National University of Singapore team has introduced PEEK, accepted at NeurIPS 2026, to address exposure bias in diffusion models. During deterministic sampling, PEEK peeks one step ahead and feeds the lower-noise prediction back as the current-step input, correcting drift earlier at the same step budget. It is training-free and plug-and-play, lowering FID by up to 49.3 points.

原文标题：新国立 PEEK 采样法让扩散模型 FID 最高降 49 点

Why it matters：免训练、即插即用的扩散采样改进，在同等步数下带来显著 FID 收益，对生成模型实践者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Meta 开源 TLX 扩展 Triton 直控底层硬件
item.description:
Meta 详细披露了 TLX（Triton 底层扩展），让 Triton 内核可直接从 Python 控制 warp group、屏障、TMA 与集群，核心是 MIMW 多指令多 warp 调度模型。在 H100 上 6 种 FP16 GEMM 形状性能与 cuBLAS 差距在 -0.9% 至 +3.7% 之间，B200 上不规则注意力内核前向快约 13%、反向快 50%，但稠密 LLM 前向注意力仅达 FlashAttention-4 的约 87%。TLX 已用于 Meta 广告训练、推理与 MoE 预训练内核，覆盖 Hopper、Blackwell 及 AMD MI300/MI350，以 MIT 协议作为上游 Triton 插件发布。

Why it matters：Meta 将 Triton 的可控粒度下沉到 warp group 级并开源，为 GPU 内核优化提供了可复用的新范式。
